references.geographic_scope: Offshore South Equatorial Current System along the Fernando de Noronha chain, northeast Brazil; central SEC branch in Figure1, distinct from coastal NBC/NBUC and eastward SEUC. Regional multi-station support, not an exact axis/profile coordinate.
references.temporal_scope: ABRACOS1 September–October2015 austral spring and ABRACOS2 April–May2017 austral autumn, RV Antea. One author regional description across the two survey comparisons, not two independent depth measurements or an annual climatology.

references.qualification: One regional rounded depth summary. No exact lower boundary or100m physical thickness: SADCP nominal support starts15m, and Figure4F shows current magnitude without zonal sign. Direction/identity and100m come from prose.15–700m instrument range and500m displayed ADCP limit are not current boundaries. Shaded standard deviations describe velocity profiles, not depth uncertainty. Autumn2017 stronger cSEC and spring2015 stronger SEUC are qualitative source comparisons, not depth extrema or a seasonal depth envelope. Do not inherit NBUC140–320m, shear40–140m or320–450m, epipelagic200m, CTD1000m, acoustic backscatter layers or their thresholds. No whole-route projection, width join or volume.
